name: News in One Minute
summary: Turns a news article into a one-minute vertical news short: a script checked against the article, editor review, narration, article photos and data cards, captions, in an editable Draft.

compatibility.selects: Selects 2.0.763 or later with narration for plug-in panels (selects.narration) and plug-in storage. Uses askAI and runScript, the host's files and bundled ffmpeg; no shell, no Python. Narration is ElevenLabs v4 through Selects, billed to the user's Selects credits by input characters. Verified on macOS (Selects Staging 2.0.763). Not yet verified on Windows.

en.name: News in One Minute
en.summary: Turns a news article into a one-minute vertical news short: a script checked against the article, editor review, narration, article photos and data cards, captions, in an editable Draft.

ko.name: 1분 뉴스 쇼츠
ko.summary: 기사 한 편으로 1분 세로 뉴스 쇼츠를 만듭니다. 원문과 대조한 대본, 편집자 검토, 나레이션, 기사 사진과 데이터 카드, 자막이 편집 가능한 Draft로 들어갑니다.

ja.name: 1分ニュースショート
ja.summary: ニュース記事から1分の縦型ニュース動画を作ります。記事と照合した台本、編集者の確認、ナレーション、記事写真とデータカード、字幕を編集できるDraftにまとめます。

zh.name: 一分钟新闻短视频
zh.summary: 把一篇新闻报道做成一分钟竖屏新闻短视频：与原文核对的脚本、编辑审核、旁白、新闻图片和数据卡片、字幕，生成可编辑的 Draft。

de.name: Nachrichten in einer Minute
de.summary: Macht aus einem Nachrichtenartikel ein einminütiges Hochformat-Video: mit dem Artikel abgeglichenes Skript, redaktionelle Prüfung, Sprecher, Artikelfotos und Datenkarten, Untertitel in einem bearbeitbaren Draft.

es.name: Noticias en un minuto
es.summary: Convierte un artículo en un vídeo vertical de noticias de un minuto: guion contrastado con el artículo, revisión editorial, narración, fotos y tarjetas de datos, subtítulos, en un Draft editable.

fr.name: L'info en une minute
fr.summary: Transforme un article en vidéo verticale d'une minute : script vérifié contre l'article, relecture, narration, photos et cartes de données, sous-titres, dans un Draft modifiable.

it.name: Notizie in un minuto
it.summary: Trasforma un articolo in un video verticale di un minuto: testo verificato sull'articolo, revisione, voce narrante, foto e schede dati, sottotitoli, in un Draft modificabile.

pt.name: Notícias em um minuto
pt.summary: Transforma um artigo num vídeo vertical de notícias de um minuto: roteiro conferido com o artigo, revisão, narração, fotos e cartões de dados, legendas, num Draft editável.

tr.name: Bir dakikada haber
tr.summary: Bir haber makalesinden bir dakikalık dikey haber videosu yapar: makaleyle karşılaştırılmış metin, editör onayı, seslendirme, makale fotoğrafları ve veri kartları, altyazılar, düzenlenebilir bir Draft içinde.
